name: gc-minimal-zine-poster-v0-3
title_zh: 纸感诗性海报生成器，留白与单色点睛
tagline_zh: 大留白、一处拼贴、一个色彩重音
tagline_en: Hand it a sentence, an article, a mood or a photo and get a paper-textured minimal zine poster — vast negative space, one small collage anchor, experimental typography, a single clear color accent.
desc_en: Generate or analyze poetic paper-texture minimal zine posters with large negative space, a small editorial collage or visual anchor, experimental typography, and one clear color accent. Use when the user gives a theme, sentence, article, mood, object, photo, content brief, reference images, or an image folder and wants a final poster image, a production-ready image prompt, reusable style rules, or
why_zh: 卖的是克制。带自测集，作者在维护风格一致性。
why_en: Rare in that what it sells is restraint — the hardest thing for a prompt to reproduce reliably. It ships an eval set, so the author is actually maintaining that consistency.
limit_zh: 只出竖版纸感海报。字必须短，长文案会写糊。
limit_en: Needs a built-in image tool, fed by referenced_image_paths or at most five in-session images. One form only: vertical, paper-textured, heavy negative space. Keep poster text short — image models garble long copy. On a fidelity miss it regenerates once, then says outright that it failed.
title_en: Poetic paper-texture poster maker with bold whitespace
